postings.title: Data Security Consultant
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Data Security Consultant to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Secure Infrastructure domain.
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Data Security Specialist who wants to guide our clients through their data security efforts in our Secure Infrastructure team.
Secure Infrastructure
Looking at the actual threat landscape today, it’s more important than ever to design and build infrastructure solutions that incorporate correct and relevant security features. The team works closely together using their combined knowledge and experience gathered from different projects and Incident Response cases to help our customers stay ahead of the threat actors. We continuously help customers improve their security posture within cloud, data center, endpoint management, identity, M365, networking and now Data Security.
The Role
As the digital landscape continues to evolve, we see data security emerging as a critical business area within cybersecurity. With the exponential growth of sensitive data being generated, shared, and stored across different platforms, organizations face unprecedented challenges in protecting their most valuable asset: their information.
As a Data Security Consultant at Truesec, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients protect their most valuable information. You will take ownership in configuring and optimising Microsoft Purview solutions and policies, managing data security configurations within Microsoft Information Protection, and deploying policies to protect critical assets across tools like Data Loss Prevention and Insider Risk Management. This role combines strategic planning with hands-on implementation, ensuring your contributions directly strengthen our clients’ data security posture and support the delivery of robust security solutions.
Your Potential Background
Experience in Microsoft Purview, including configuration of policies in various Purview tools (such as Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management)
An understanding of information protection strategies and tools, including encryption, rights management, and data classification solutions
Experience working with Azure services (e.g., M365, Defender)
Ability to deliver training and workshops, empowering clients and colleagues with practical knowledge of data security best practices
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 or similar data protection regulations.
Desired Skills
Knowledge of data security frameworks and ability to develop security baselines for data security projects
Technical acumen for implementing and troubleshooting data security systems
Relevant certifications (e.g., Information Security Administrator Associate)
Understanding of AI technologies and the specific security risks they present, with experience implementing protective measures with Azure tools
Experience integrating security into development and operational workflows
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

postings.title: Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR)
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response business unit.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR) who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.
CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)
Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in Sweden and worldwide. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber-attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.
The Role
You will be part of our dedicated, global Incident Response Team, assisting customers that are affected by cyber-attacks, by collecting file-, memory-, and network-related information and logfiles, connecting the dots and backtracking exactly what a threat actor has done in the environment to locate possible backdoors, data exfiltration, or proof of other malicious activity.
Your Potential Background
We believe that you have a background in penetration testing, red teaming, or enterprise security. You possess a thorough, analytic, and organized mindset with a good understanding of how a corporate enterprise IT environment works, and how threat actors operate when gaining access. You, as a person, actively seek solutions and like to work as part of a team with members that collaborate, help, and support each other.
Required Skills:
Analytic mindset
Scripting skills
Enterprise IT understanding
Report writing
Bonus Skills:
Memory and disk analytics
Linux/AWS/Google Cloud.

postings.title: Identity Engineer – Sailpoint
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Identity Engineers with a focus on Sailpoint to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Identity & Access Management domain.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond and Recover.
Today, we employ more than 400 employees – and as the demand for cybersecurity grows, we need to grow too. We are looking for Identity Engineers – Sailpoint to join our Identity & Access Management (IAM) team operating in Denmark and Sweden.
So, if you want to become an expert in a growing security discipline within one of the leading technologies, alongside a dynamic, ambitious, and welcoming team of specialists, then you might be what we are looking for.
Identity Security team
Our team of experts includes professionals with diverse skill sets: engineers, consultants, architects, process specialists, and strategists. Together, we support our customers to prepare, initiate, develop and mature their IAM programs.
As a dedicated SailPoint partner in the Nordics, we take pride in contributing to the security and management of over 40,000 identities.
Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. You will be surrounded by experts who support and challenge each other to grow, whether through knowledge-sharing, hands-on problem-solving, or staying ahead of the latest identity threats. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger, which is why we value team members from different backgrounds, industries, and walks of life.
The Role you can own if you join the team
As a Identity Engineer – Sailpoint, you will join a dedicated and supportive team of identity experts, working together to help our customers implement and maintain cutting-edge SailPoint technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with architects and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into robust identity solutions. Whether you’re configuring connectors, designing rules and workflows, or developing custom provisioning logic, you’ll play a key role in delivering secure and efficient identity management for our clients.
Typical tasks could be:
Work with architects and stakeholders to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Configure and maintain SailPoint connectors, design rules, and Life Cycle Management (LCM) workflows.
Develop and maintain provisioning solutions tailored to customer application landscapes.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues within SailPoint IdentityIQ environments.
Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and compliance.
Support the integration of SailPoint with various platforms and applications.
Participate in test and release management for identity solutions.
Your Potential Background
You might come from a variety of backgrounds, such as system administration or consulting, with hands-on experience in implementing SailPoint technologies. Whether you have worked on new projects or maintained existing installations, your technical curiosity and structured approach set you apart. If you enjoy working collaboratively, taking responsibility, and seeing projects through from start to finish, we would love to hear from you.
What would we like to see from you?
Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ implementation.
Proficiency in Java and Beanshell scripting.
Experience with PowerShell and Log4j2.
Familiarity with on-prem environments and the underlying infrastructure required to operate SailPoint solutions.
Ability to communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing.
A strong desire to learn and grow within the identity space.
You get bonus points if you tick one or more of these boxes:
While the following skills and experiences are a plus, they are not required—if you are motivated to learn and grow, we encourage you to apply!
Previous experience with Active Directory & Entra ID.
Knowledge of Azure IaaS & PaaS, Microsoft Graph, and Apache Tomcat.
Familiarity with databases and SQL. Experience with SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and authentication protocols.
Knowledge of Windows/Linux Server environments.
Understanding of REST/SOAP web services, JSON, and SCIM 2.0.
SailPoint certifications are highly appreciated.
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

postings.title: Information Security Officer
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Information Security Officer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Information Security Officer who wants to make a difference.
The Global Security and Compliance (GSC) function at Truesec plays a pivotal role in ensuring that Truesec’s cyber resilience is adapted to our threat profile and remains aligned with the evolving technology landscape, including AI. As a leading Nordic cyber security provider, Truesec is held to the highest standards, and it is the responsibility of the GSC function to ensure that industry best practices and information security and compliance standards are consistently upheld in the organization.
You will work closely with the CISO to ensure our security goals and activities align with the threat landscape and that our cyber strategies are effectively implemented and continuously improved. This entails:
• Supporting the business on security, privacy, and the interpretation of requirements. In a dynamic technology environment, GSC works closely with teams across Truesec to support internal initiatives, such as proof-of-concepts for new security technologies.
• Communication with stakeholders, including responding to security requirements in RFPs and questionnaires.
• Coordinate incident management, monitoring and security measures with our SOC and IT SecOps team
• Working with AI to improve the GSC processes and empower the organization in decision making.
• Performing yearly internal audits according to the ISO 27001 standard and participating in the external ISO audits.
• Risk management including working with Truesec Intelligence to assess risk profile. You will work closely with leading experts in various fields, including our SOC, IR, Protective Security Manager, Human Threat Intelligence, Threat Intelligence.
• Monitor changes in the statutory and regulatory landscape in cooperation with Internal Legal, ensuring that our governing documents remain up to date and aligned with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
You bring solid experience from IT or information security, gained in a consulting, audit or line role, together with a broad and current understanding of the cyber threat landscape. You can assess how emerging threats may affect the organisation and translate them into clear priorities, proportionate controls and practical improvements.
You understand modern security architectures and technologies, including cloud security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and detection and response, and can confidently challenge technical teams, suppliers and proposed solutions.
Required Skills:
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience with implementing and governing an Information Management System
Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS 18, ISO 27001, SOC2, and PCI DSS. Our ITSM is certified according to ISO 27001.
Proficiency in conducting security audits and assessments
Proficiency in risk management
Strong analytical and report-writing skills
Proficient in Swedish & English, both written and spoken.
Bonus Skills:
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, MCSE CIPP/E
Experience from implementing ISO 27001 in an organization
Legal graduate/legal experience
Knowledge of legislation such as GDPR, NIS directive and the Protective Security Act
Experience with incident response, continuity- and crisis management
Due to the sensitivity of our work, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.

postings.title: Key Account Manager
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager for our commercial organization.
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Key Account Manager to join our Truesec team and play a pivotal role in accelerating growth across the Finish market.
As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for new businesses and managing relationships, also develop a portfolio of strategic customers. By acting as a trusted advisor and business partner to senior stakeholders, your mission is to identify opportunities, create long-term value, and drive sustainable revenue growth by aligning our services with our customers’ business objectives.
This is not a transactional sales role. We are looking for someone who thrives on building executive relationships, uncovering strategic opportunities, navigating complex organisations, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
What you will do:
• Initiate and drive new business acquisitions.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with major Enterprise clients, ensuring their needs are met and they are satisfied with Truesec’s services.
• Serve as the main point of contact for client inquiries, concerns, and feedback, providing timely and effective solutions.
• Gain a deep understanding of clients’ business objectives and cybersecurity needs.
• Identify and capitalize on opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Truesec’s products and services.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to client needs.
• Monitor and report on account performance, client satisfaction, and market trends.
• Prepare and present regular account reviews and reports to both clients and Truesec’s management.
• Handle any client issues or complaints with professionalism and efficiency.
• Stay informed about industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive landscape to provide clients with the best possible advice and solutions.
Too succeed in this role, we believe that you
• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.
• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.
• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.
• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted partnerships and creating value for customers.
• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.
• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Finish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Finnish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Finnish work permit.

postings.title: Principal Penetration Tester
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Principal Penetration Tester to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Offensive Security team.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Principal Penetration Tester who wants to make a difference in our Offensive Security Team.
Offensive Security Team
Truesec’s Offensive Security Team is a group of dedicated cybersecurity specialists working proactively to help organizations protect themselves against cyber breaches by identifying vulnerabilities before they are exploited. As part of this team, you’ll collaborate closely with some of the world’s top security experts, leveraging combined knowledge and experience to conduct penetration tests, security assessments, and advanced red and purple team engagements.
The work is highly technical and focuses on uncovering security weaknesses in enterprise- and cloud environments, including mobile applications, cloud platforms, IOT/OT systems, and both Linux and Microsoft infrastructures. Team members lead assignments from start to finish, maintaining direct contact with customers and driving projects alongside colleagues, all with the shared mission of making a real difference in cybersecurity and contributing to a safer digital world
About the Role
As a Principal Penetration Tester within Truesec’s Offensive Security Team, you will be at the forefront of protecting organizations against advanced cyber threats. This is a unique opportunity to work alongside some of the world’s most dedicated and talented cyber specialists. You will lead and deliver highly complex offensive security engagements—ranging from advanced penetration tests to red and purple team exercises—across enterprise environments, cloud platforms, and specialized domains such as IOT/OT.
Your role extends beyond technical execution: you’ll shape strategic initiatives, guide and mentor teams, and make high-level decisions that influence both Truesec’s direction and our clients’ long-term cyber resilience. You will own key customer deliveries from start to finish, navigate complex and undefined challenges, and continuously develop tools, processes, and solutions critical to our ongoing success. As a Principal, you serve as a guiding star—demonstrating best practices, fostering collaboration, and ensuring projects remain focused and impactful.
Your Background
At least 10+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or related fields.
Recognized as a subject-matter expert with deep and broad expertise across multiple platforms, technologies, and methodologies.
Proven track record of leading highly complex security assessments and offensive engagements.
Experience managing critical customer projects, mentoring teams, and contributing to the development of new tools, processes, or services.
Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and a genuine desire to make a difference for clients and the wider community.
Required Skills
You should meet most of the following requirements, or be a true expert in several:
Extensive experience in penetration testing of enterprise environments.
Deep knowledge of identifying vulnerabilities in both Windows and Linux systems.
Advanced skills in network-based penetration tests, credentials extraction, and lateral movement.
Expertise in penetration testing of mobile applications, IOT/OT systems, and cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
Ability to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-level stakeholders.
Strategic mindset with the ability to make decisions affecting business direction and customer outcomes.
Experience in leading projects and mentoring colleagues.
Bonus skills
Sysadmin background or experience managing large-scale IT environments.

postings.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
postings.description:
Vill du vara med i framkant och skydda vårt samhälle mot cyberhot? Vi söker en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill bli en del av ett passionerat team av cyberspecialister inom vårt Secure Development-område.
Sedan 2005 har Truesec varit ett renodlat cybersäkerhetsföretag, drivet av ett tydligt syfte: att skapa trygghet och hållbarhet i en digital värld genom att förebygga cyberintrång och minimera deras påverkan.
Genom åren har vi vunnit förtroende hos organisationer världen över och byggt ett starkt internationellt anseende. Vårt team består av engagerade specialister som täcker hela cybersäkerhetsspektrat – med kompetens inom Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond och Recover.
Idag är vi omkring 400 medarbetare – och i takt med att cyberbrottsligheten ökar behöver vi också växa. För att stötta den utvecklingen söker vi nu en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill göra verklig skillnad.
Produkter, applikationer och leveransflöden blir allt oftare måltavlor för hotaktörer, vilket gör säkerhet till en avgörande del i varje steg av modern utveckling. Som en del av Truesecs Secure Development-team hjälper våra specialister inom produkt- och applikationssäkerhet kunder genom tekniskt kodnära stöd, praktiska workshops, utbildning inom säker utveckling och DevSecOps samt längre uppdrag där de blir en integrerad del av team som bygger säkra lösningar från grunden. Med stöd av erfarenhet, egna verktyg och våra tjänster hjälper vi kunder att stärka sitt försvar och säkerställa robusta, framtidssäkra applikationer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med engagerade experter i ett ledande cyber tech-bolag med ett viktigt uppdrag.
Som Senior Application Security Engineer på Truesec kommer du att arbeta nära olika kunder för att stärka deras utvecklingsorganisationer genom skräddarsydda tekniska lösningar. Rollen innebär att identifiera sårbarheter i system, genomföra kodgranskningar och guida kunder i säkra utvecklingsmetoder.
Du kommer att analysera kod och arkitektur, ge råd kring hantering av tekniska risker och sårbarheter, leda hotmodelleringssessioner och driva workshops för att höja säkerhetsmedvetenheten. Vi uppmuntrar till kontinuerligt lärande genom löpande utbildning och branschevent, så att du alltid kan ligga i framkant inom cybersäkerhet. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och bygga säkra, motståndskraftiga system – både självständigt och tillsammans med vårt expertteam..
Applikations- och produktsäkerhet är ett brett område, och vi välkomnar kandidater med olika typer av bakgrund. Tillsammans hjälper vi kunder uppnå relevanta säkerhetskrav genom hela utvecklingskedjan, både för applikationer och fysiska produkter.
Du kan till exempel vara en applikationssäkerhetsexpert med erfarenhet av hotmodellering, sårbarhetsbedömningar, kodgranskning och säker mjukvaruutveckling.Kanske är du utvecklare med ett starkt säkerhetsintresse och kunskap inom säker kod, inputvalidering, accesskontroll, molnsäkerhet eller kryptografi.
Om du är penetrationstestare med kodintresse ser vi mycket positivt på din förmåga att identifiera och exploatera sårbarheter för att tydliggöra deras affärspåverkan. Har du även erfarenhet av utveckling av inbyggda system ser vi positivt på kunskaper inom hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar. Vi ser gärna att du har god kunskap på både engelska och svenska i skrift och tal.
Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av
Säker utveckling och DevSecOps
Mjukvaruarkitektur och design
Programmeringskunskaper i ett eller flera språk, till exempel Java, C#, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust eller Go
Meriterande erfarenhet
Kryptografi, autentisering och auktorisering
Distribuerade system, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes
Molnplattformar (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Hotmodellering och säkerhetsbedömningar
Säker användning av agentisk AI
OAuth 2, OpenID Connect, JWT och liknande autentiserings- och auktoriseringsmetoder
Verktyg för automatiserad sårbarhetsidentifiering
Penetrationstestning
Hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar
Sårbarhetshantering
Produktsäkerhetsstandarder och regleringar (till exempel Cyber Resilience Act, CRA)
På grund av uppdragens känsliga karaktär behöver du ha svenskt medborgarskap, medborgarskap i ett EU-land eller ett giltigt svenskt arbetstillstånd.
Om du verkligen vill göra skillnad och bidra till att göra världen lite säkrare, då är det här rätt plats för dig. På Truesec får du vara med i frontlinjen i kampen mot cyberbrottslighet i stället för att bara läsa om den i nyheterna. Det här är din chans att bli en del av en spännande resa i ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag – och att lära av några av de främsta inom sitt område.
Så, är du redo att teama upp med ett av de mest engagerade expertteamen och bli en del av ett meningsfullt uppdrag? Då ser vi fram emot att lära känna dig!

postings.title: Senior IAM Architect – SailPoint
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Senior IAM Architect with a focus on SailPoint to join our Identity & Access Management domain and team up with some of the most dedicated cyber specialists in the industry.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond and Recover.
Today, we employ more than 400 employees – and as the demand for cybersecurity grows, we need to grow too. We are looking for a Senior IAM Architect – Sailpoint to join our Identity & Access Management (IAM) team operating in Denmark and Sweden.
The IAM team
Identity & Access Management (IAM) is a strategically important service area at Truesec, where we help our customers design, implement, and operate secure and scalable identity solutions across complex hybrid and cloud environments.
We work closely with our customers’ security, IT, and business teams, delivering IAM services spanning Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Zero Trust architectures.
The Role
You act as a trusted advisor to customers, support delivery teams with architectural guidance, and contribute to the continuous evolution of Truesecs IAM services.
What you’ll do
Own and design end-to-end IAM architectures across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments
Define architecture principles, standards, and best practices within IAM
Lead and support implementations within Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and modern authentication/authorization and federation
Translate business and security requirements into practical, secure technical designs
Facilitate customer dialogue, workshops, and architectural decision-making
Mentor and coach IAM engineers through knowledge sharing, reviews, and hands-on guidance
Contribute to presales activities, solution scoping, and architectural input in proposals
Collaborate with Information Security on risk assessments, controls, and compliance
Stay on top of IAM trends, vendors, and emerging technologies to evolve our services
Your Potential Background

- Extensive experience in IAM engineering and architecture (typically 7-10+ years)
Proven experience designing complex IAM solutions in enterprise environments
Strong expertise in IGA platforms such as SailPoint, Omada, or similar
Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and related identity services
Strong understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML)
Knowledge of role and access models (RBAC/ABAC) and identity lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver)
Experience working with compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2)
Ability to balance hands-on technical work with architectural and strategic responsibilities
Strong communication skills and confidence working with both technical teams and senior stakeholders
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, CISM) are a plus, but not required
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

postings.title: Senior Penetration Tester
postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Senior Penetration Tester to team up with the most dedicated team of cybersecurity specialists in our Offensive Security team.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Senior Penetration Tester who wants to make a difference in our Offensive Security Team.
Offensive Security Team
Truesec’s Offensive Security Team is a group of dedicated cybersecurity specialists working proactively to help organizations protect themselves against cyber breaches by identifying vulnerabilities before they are exploited. As part of this team, you’ll collaborate closely with some of the world’s top security experts, leveraging combined knowledge and experience to conduct penetration tests, security assessments, and advanced red and purple team engagements.
The work is highly technical and focuses on uncovering security weaknesses in enterprise- and cloud environments, including mobile applications, cloud platforms, IOT/OT systems, and both Linux and Microsoft infrastructures. Team members lead assignments from start to finish, maintaining direct contact with customers and driving projects alongside colleagues, all with the shared mission of making a real difference in cybersecurity and contributing to a safer digital world
The Role
In this role, you will be part of the Offensive Security Team at Truesec, granting you the opportunity to work with some of the best security specialists in the world. As a Senior Penetration tester you will primarily conduct advanced security reviews and penetration tests as well as lead and drive the projects with a colleague. You will be leading the assignments from start to finish, meaning that you will be in close contact with our customers for initiation meetings and lead the entire testing-process, as well as leading other colleagues in your team within the projects.
The assignments are performed on a technical level where you will actively look for security vulnerabilities, mostly in enterprise environments. Typical projects can be penetration testing of mobile applications, Linux and Microsoft environments, AWS, Google, and IOT/OT or advanced red and purple teaming assignments.
To succeed in this role we believe that you are a true expert in a specific area or technology and repeatedly mastermind other implementations with the ambition to make a difference.
Your Potential Background
We all have various backgrounds, but what we have in common is our love and joy of IT security and hacking. If you share our passion, join us!
Required Skills:
You should meet most of the following requirements, or be a true expert in a few.
Experience in penetration testing of enterprise environments.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities in both Windows and Linux systems.
Experience in network-based penetration tests.
Experience in credentials extraction and lateral movement.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities on mobile applications.
Experience in penetration testing of IOT/OT systems.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities in cloud environments.
Ability to present findings to a non-technical audience.
Bonus Skills:
Sysadmin experience.
Ability to understand arbitrary programming language.
Full proficiency in at least one programming language.
Experience of code assisted/code review-based penetration testing.

postings.description:
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Senior Penetration Tester to team up with the most dedicated team of cybersecurity specialists in our Offensive Security team.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Senior Penetration Tester who wants to make a difference in our Offensive Security Team.
Offensive Security Team
Truesec’s Offensive Security Team is a group of dedicated cybersecurity specialists working proactively to help organizations protect themselves against cyber breaches by identifying vulnerabilities before they are exploited. As part of this team, you’ll collaborate closely with some of the world’s top security experts, leveraging combined knowledge and experience to conduct penetration tests, security assessments, and advanced red and purple team engagements.
The work is highly technical and focuses on uncovering security weaknesses in enterprise- and cloud environments, including mobile applications, cloud platforms, IOT/OT systems, and both Linux and Microsoft infrastructures. Team members lead assignments from start to finish, maintaining direct contact with customers and driving projects alongside colleagues, all with the shared mission of making a real difference in cybersecurity and contributing to a safer digital world
The Role
In this role, you will be part of the Offensive Security Team at Truesec, granting you the opportunity to work with some of the best security specialists in the world. As a Senior Penetration tester you will primarily conduct advanced security reviews and penetration tests as well as lead and drive the projects with a colleague. You will be leading the assignments from start to finish, meaning that you will be in close contact with our customers for initiation meetings and lead the entire testing-process, as well as leading other colleagues in your team within the projects.
The assignments are performed on a technical level where you will actively look for security vulnerabilities, mostly in enterprise environments. Typical projects can be penetration testing of mobile applications, Linux and Microsoft environments, AWS, Google, and IOT/OT or advanced red and purple teaming assignments.
To succeed in this role we believe that you are a true expert in a specific area or technology and repeatedly mastermind other implementations with the ambition to make a difference.
Your Potential Background
We all have various backgrounds, but what we have in common is our love and joy of IT security and hacking. If you share our passion, join us!
Required Skills:
You should meet most of the following requirements, or be a true expert in a few.
Experience in penetration testing of enterprise environments.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities in both Windows and Linux systems.
Experience in network-based penetration tests.
Experience in credentials extraction and lateral movement.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities on mobile applications.
Experience in penetration testing of IOT/OT systems.
Ability to identify vulnerabilities in cloud environments.
Ability to present findings to a non-technical audience.
Bonus Skills:
Sysadmin experience.
Ability to understand arbitrary programming language.
Full proficiency in at least one programming language.
Experience of code assisted/code review-based penetration testing.
Relevant security related certifications.

Active Directory Security
Windows server Security
Azure Security
Microsoft 365 Security

Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell and/or Python
Cloud migration journeys from On-prem to Azure.

Hypervisor knowledge of Hyper-V, VMware.
